summary: David Woo argues the market is incorrectly pricing in a soft landing scenario. He believes inflation will remain high due to China's reopening and potential Russian offensive in Ukraine, both of which would push energy prices higher. He recommends betting against market consensus by buying oil futures and shorting S&P 500, while avoiding European equities including OMX.
key_takeaways: China reopening will boost oil demand significantly
Russian offensive could drive energy prices higher
